# r-efi provenance

Cargo resolves `r-efi 6.0.0` from crates.io. Its packaged
`.cargo_vcs_info.json` binds the crate to upstream commit
`7e1b0322d31d625f81a5656096330934f9cd835d`.

`AUTHORS` is an exact copy from that commit and has SHA-256
`d027e91dbc9cdbb2f1190068e498bd6b61cff022b6a032b191021ba658d96111`.
It is the upstream revision's primary licensing and copyright file. The
revision contains no standalone `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, or `COPYING` files; its
manifest declares `MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR LGPL-2.1-or-later`, and `AUTHORS`
contains the MIT terms plus Apache and LGPL notices and references.

`r-efi` is in the resolved target-specific build/test closure. This retained
file does not assert that `r-efi` contributes bytes to a particular binary.
